All questions are backward from the answer, effectively asking for the legal issue/label. I'm keeping the relation type "associated_legal_issue" consistent. I'm using the provided aliases ("terrorism," and both "conflict of interest" and "conflict-of-interest"). English only and JSON only, confirmed.

Finally, I need to format the JSON correctly. I'm including the answer and aliases within the proper JSON structure and ensuring proper escaping.
